# Attribution and scope

The nine-call joint-prefix extension, compatible helper relabeling,
constructive replay, independent audits, portable verification and packaging
were prepared for Jonathan with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
New contributions are under Apache-2.0; LICENSE is included.

Direct predecessors:

- Dominik Scholz's PR571 at b7bdc5a8de18fcf418cfb9c7d83a2b1097a5e4a3
  supplies the literal joint prefix, complete width-seven composition and source
  owner geometry. Its OpenAI Codex assistance and predecessor credits are
  retained unchanged in proof/PR571-NOTICE.txt and
  proof/PR571-COMPOSITION-NOTICE.md. Its 63 width-seven providers are reproduced
  exactly; the new contribution extends the prefix/eight-cold construction to
  its nine ordinary calls with compatible literal helper swaps.

- Jeremy Kothe's PR568 at 71c99ac935a33bb7b59a1b4a7af8725a939b0b90 supplies

  research agents with Claude Code (Anthropic) assistance. The full notice is
  retained at proof/PR568-NOTICE.md.
- Dominik Scholz's PR569 at f20a68b4b126780419c292571411022bb1d006d6 supplies
  paid width-seven entrances and whole-owner geometry, with OpenAI Codex
  assistance. Its original NOTICE is retained at proof/PR569-NOTICE.txt.
- Jonathan's PR567 at 7f452897d67282a76ada6df0162d34a751d5f3e6 supplies portable
  reconstruction and complete generated-artifact identity checks, with OpenAI
  Codex assistance. Its notice is retained at proof/PR567-NOTICE.md.

The packing method builds on higherbeing's open allocator and pattern/Hall
approach, credited with Claude Code assistance, and Dugongue's asynchronous
schedule and emitter/auditor. The retained source geometry was obtained through whole-owner packing.
This extension uses a source-bound helper permutation and has no optimizer
dependency. Its physical slots and complete provider accounting are checked
independently.

Eumemic/Codex PR564, PR561 and PR562 supply the first cold word, complete
zero/four/eight provider interfaces, controller, physical verifier and invoice
lineage. Full unchanged source packages and notices from PR558
(060b137c8a6f9d73fd7864c7f8cf2736d6441774) and Rohan Arun's PR559
(d858c0b2edcc704ef370b3c96dc51a75439b77b0) remain under vendor/.
The native recurrence credits PR559's exact full-cover argument.

The unchanged PR543 bit supplier is cited at
2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535. Its complete profile is repriced;
